zoneNotes: OSM has no landuse polygon for the KLCC development, so the zones are the four landmark complexes by OSM building name (an outline and the building:parts mapped inside it): the Petronas Twin Towers (OSM 'Menara Berkembar Petronas', drawn as 25 stepped parts), Suria KLCC, the KL Convention Centre (OSM 'Pusat Konvensyen Kuala Lumpur') and Ombak KLCC (OSM 'Plaza Ombak KLCC', building=mall, opened 21 Aug 2026).
partParentNotes: way/137396365 is the Petronas Towers skybridge (OSM building:part, min_height 170 m, height 180 m). Its centre lies inside both the Suria KLCC outline (the podium) and the towers outline; it belongs to the towers.
anchorNotes: WALKWAY: the southern end of the KLCC–Bukit Bintang pedestrian walkway inside the study square, where it leaves towards Pavilion (a future spot).
routeNotes: routes: the walk between the two stations, KLCC (Kelana Jaya Line, red) and Persiaran KLCC (Putrajaya Line, yellow): they are not an official interchange, so changing lines means walking.
modelNotes: Both lines run in tunnels here, so their tracks and trains are drawn in the underground view; undergroundStops are where their trains stop. The KL Monorail touches the south-west corner on its viaduct (above ground). parkPaths: the walkways and jogging track inside KLCC Park (OSM way 10590000) are part of the base map, shown in every chapter. shapes: Ombak KLCC (KPF, opened 2026) is a six-storey retail podium with a ribbon-like facade and a massive cantilevered section towards the public plaza (Wikipedia – Ombak KLCC, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ombak_KLCC). It is drawn with a sculpted section under the cited 30 m: the wave crest at the north end (Jalan Binjai, by MRT entrances A and C), the roof sweeping down to about 20 m (0.68) at the south end, and the southern half, facing the Stargazing Plaza, cantilevered over a recessed base from mid-length, lifted about 12 m (0.4) at its tip; eight facade ribbons rising with the roofline, and the roof oculus (an oval about 38 × 30 m) in the northern half. The profile is read off photos (Wikimedia Commons, Category:Ombak KLCC: 'Ombak KLCC as seen from Menara Ilham 01', 'Ombak KLCC at night (2026)', 'Ombak KLCC 20260905 (1)/(2)', 'Ombak KLCC in 2025') and KPF's concept sketches (the shell roof with its oval skylight over the high end, the terraced roof garden, the cantilever over a glazed base); they are illustrative, not surveyed.
